_comment_project: CurrencyConverter Python project using Poetry, Semantic Release, and commitlint.
_comment_scripts: Scripts to run Semantic Release easily.

scripts._comment_release: Runs full Semantic Release: updates version, changelog, commits, and optionally publishes to PyPI.
scripts._comment_release_dry: Simulates Semantic Release without making any changes; good for testing configuration.

_comment_devDependencies: Development-only packages used for automation and commit linting.

devDependencies._comment_commitlint: Enforces Conventional Commit messages to make Semantic Release work reliably.
devDependencies._comment_mermaid: CLI for generating diagrams from Mermaid syntax; optional, for documentation visuals.
devDependencies._comment_commit_analyzer: Analyzes commit messages to determine next version (patch/minor/major).
devDependencies._comment_release_notes_generator: Generates the notes for changelog from commit messages.
devDependencies._comment_exec: Runs shell commands: here used to update Poetry version and publish to PyPI.
devDependencies._comment_git: Commits updated pyproject.toml and changelog back to Git.
